opportunities.title: Historic buildings and structures

amount.raw: Generally, £1,000 to £30,000 (average approx. £15,000). Sometimes larger sums are considered.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, organisations with exempt charitable status, recognised public bodies, Community Benefit Societies, and Community Interest Companies limited by guarantee. Project must be UK based, not complete, and focus on a listed building or structure.
opportunities.summary: Funds the preservation and repair of listed historic buildings, structures and architectural features, with special consideration for sustainable conservation and re-use of at-risk buildings of outstanding importance. Stage one applications considered on a rolling basis; small grants (£5,000 or less) considered on a rolling basis between meetings.

opportunities.title: Places of worship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Anglican churches must apply via the ChurchCare conservation grants scheme; all other denominations, faiths and cathedrals may apply directly to the Pilgrim Trust. Applicants must be UK registered charities, organisations with exempt charitable status, or recognised public bodies.
opportunities.summary: Funds the conservation of historic interiors and historic objects (bells, books, manuscripts, clocks, organs, stained glass, wall paintings, churchyard structures, etc.) in places of worship open for regular worship, including commissioning conservation reports. No longer provides repair grants to places of worship open for active worship; applications for sustainable re-use of redundant/closed places of worship go through the Historic Buildings programme.

opportunities.title: Conservation of cultural heritage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, organisations with exempt charitable status, recognised public bodies, Community Benefit Societies, and Community Interest Companies limited by guarantee. Applicants must not be eligible for the AIM and NMCT grant schemes. Work must be UK based and not complete.
opportunities.summary: Funds the conservation of culturally and historically significant collections and objects, including works of art, books, significant ephemera, artefacts and archives. Conservation must be carried out by an accredited conservator and informed by a conservation report. Encourages paid internships/placements and knowledge-sharing outcomes. Stage one applications considered on a rolling basis.
